channel.title: Global Fastener News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Fastener News (globalfastenernews.com)

item.title: OBITUARY: Chris Heller
item.description: Heller, 49, was Branch Operations Manager in Columbus, OH, for Triangle Fastener Corporation.

item.title: China Fastener Export Volume Grew in 2025
item.description: Full-year exports are projected to grow substantially for the second consecutive year, though the average price stood at just US$1.92 per kg, down 2.7% from 2024.

item.title: SFS Group Fastener Sales Decline
item.description: Among the group’s three business segments, Fastening Systems was the only segment to report reduced sales.

item.title: Edson Manufacturing Expands
item.description: Rivet maker Edson Manufacturing purchased a new $4 million facility in Wolcott, CT, according to the Hartford Business Journal.

item.title: BBI Hires Marketing Creative Director
item.description: Former MotorTrend Group creative director will oversee marketing for all Brighton-Best International brands.

item.title: Sunco Installs Robotic Rotary Racks
item.description: Racks have an image recognition system to enable fully automated banding, using cameras to detect whether cardboard cases lack plastic bands and applying them as needed.

item.title: SPS Submits Fastener Factory Rebuild Plans
item.description: SPS Technologies will rebuild its facility as a 350,000 sq ft aerospace manufacturing plant on the site of its former factory, which was destroyed by fire the company blames an explosion inside a compressed air system.

item.title: China Fastener Export Volume Up, Prices Down
item.description: Export volumes are expanding, while prices remain under pressure from global competition, new capacities in emerging markets, and volatility in inflation and raw material costs.

item.title: Howmet Fastening Systems Promotes Minginette
item.description: Twenty-six year fastener industry veteran was promoted to Senior Sales Director in Europe.

item.title: AI Robots Boost Aerospace Production
item.description: Thailand-based JPP Holding Co. introduced 50 AI-powered robots with vision systems to handle tasks such as screw fastening, riveting, stamping, painting, and welding.
